latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Electrical Basics & Backup Power: essential guidance for surviving power outages safely.

- Teaches users to understand and map their electrical breaker panel, including breaker sizes and circuit loads.
- Covers safe connection and operation of generators, emphasizing carbon monoxide and backfeed dangers.
- Explains when and how to use solar panels, battery backups, and how to size generators for critical loads.
- Advises users to consult licensed electricians for any panel work, following country-specific electrical standards.
- Includes up-to-date safety recommendations and sources from NEC, OSHA, and others.
- Designed for anyone preparing for or responding to extended grid outages.
